description: Clean monthly Medicare Advantage explanation of benefits with three in-network claims, no injected errors. Plan design is fictional: copays by service category, $0 labs and preventive care, a yearly out-of-pocket maximum.

sources.what: Required contents of a Medicare Advantage EOB
sources.source: CMS Part C EOB model template and instructions (Medicare Managed Care Manual ch. 4 and the Part C EOB guidance), https://www.cms.gov/medicare/health-plans/managed-care-marketing
CARIN Blue Button ExplanationOfBenefit implementation guide, https://hl7.org/fhir/us/carin-bb/
